notes: Parcoursup page: the fee shown (178 EUR/year) is the standard public-sector rate and is described for Parcoursup candidates; for a non-EU applicant with a Moroccan Bac holding differentiated "droits d'inscription différenciés" (2 902 EUR/year for Licence-level courses per the Campus France Maroc page), this amount may not apply — auditor should verify. The programme's own page explicitly excludes foreign non-EU applicants from Parcoursup. The 'français B2' listing under 'Langues et options' is not called a condition of admission in the page, though it appears in this context; treated as stated level for now. The quote 'Avoir une maîtrise du français permettant de communiquer à l’écrit et à l’oral de façon adaptée' is a general skill expectation, not a language condition. Subject requirement quotes are from general expectations and the selection test, not an explicit subject prerequisite list.
